review.notes: Fix of the KatoEulerSystems package by Claude (Opus 5.5), session claude-H833eD, issue #11543. No REV-PKG-KatoEulerSystems~adv report exists; the findings are the first package review (REV-PKG-KatoEulerSystems, needs_changes: fourteen unowned supplier rows and seven corrections) and the round-2 review REV-PKG-KatoEulerSystems~2 (#9222, accepted with seventeen corrections, merged 2026-10-21). Each was re-checked in the files and is present: the fourteen rows are supplied by PadicFamilies §§4.0.1-4.0.3 (PR #1019 head f9ad8cc) or planned here (4.1 admissibility, 4.2a, 4.5, 4.6, 5.5, 6.1, 6.3, 7.5, 7.7, conditional 6.5); the round-2 corrections (M,N>=2, explicit 1.2 transfer, N^(-k) in F^(k), p.143 locator, 6.1 and 6.6 Checks, 4.2a against X_inf, contained-cyclotomic CM, Fricke §1.5, ESKS §§2.1/2.5, SIC §2.12, odd p in 7.4/7.6, ModularForms Layer 9, consumers, Lean over fields) are all in place. An independent adversarial pass found and fixed: a false Check in 4.2a (local H2_Iw is dual to invariants over Q_v(mu_p^inf), not G_Qv; counterexample T=Z_p(2)); an overstatement in 7.2 (Kato 12.5(3) only says the local term is nonzero only under (12.5.1), with length one then; nonsplit multiplicative reduction gives zero); a garbled sentence in 4.2 on the r=1 values; the Frobenius convention of V(f), now stated with Kato (14.10.1), (14.10.3) and a computed witness. Generality: 7.4 now records that at p=2 with good ordinary reduction the torsion and the rational divisibility hold as the weight-two case of PadicFamilies §4.0.3 (Kato Thm 17.4(1)-(2), p.273, no parity condition). Missing mathematics: Kato §14, owned by no roadmap and requested by RankZeroOneBSD (allPrimeRankZeroSelmer), is now target 7.9: Thm 14.2 (finiteness of Bloch-Kato Selmer groups over abelian fields, admissible pairs, almost-all vanishing for non-CM only), the abelian-variety Bloch-Kato/Kummer comparison, Cor 14.3, Thm 14.4 and Thm 14.5, with two recorded source slips (14.5(3) prints (12.5.1) for (12.5.2); 14.13 drops (2 pi i)^(r-1) and writes f for f*). Verified by computation: H1(GL2(Z/4),(Z/4)^2)=Z/2 (4.7). lean-check: exit 0, only 8 sorry warnings, 299 lines, import Mathlib only; check_sorry_data clean; intake check-files 0 problems. No duplication on TauCetiRoadmap main 0d144d04 or Tau Ceti. Remaining for the maintainer (not defects): the other three RankZeroOneBSD extension contracts come from other papers (JSW, BSTW, Wuthrich); CM almost-all vanishing rests on Rubin's main conjecture; the round-2 upstream notes on PadicFamilies §§4.0.1 and 4.0.3 stand.
